During their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|crusade]] to conquer [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''attacked''' and conquered the [[Ciutric system/Legends|Ciutric system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] following their [[Mission to Bimmiel|assault]] on the [[MZX33291 system|Bimmiel system]]. After the attack on Ciutric, the Yuuzhan Vong advanced along the [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]] to the adjacent [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth system]], which they also [[Attack on the Vinsoth system|assaulted]]. The Ciutric system thereafter became part of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]], and remained as such until the Yuuzhan Vong's [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|defeat]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Ciutric system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" />
